about: What a motion gate verdict was measured on (docs/PEOPLE_MOTION.md §1.9). 'people': everything that decides how the game's people look and move; 'measures': the gate's own measures and limits. Each is hashed (SHA-256 over each file's path and the SHA-256 of its bytes, in path order) by HumanMotionGateTests when it writes docs/qa/gates/motion_gate.json, and again by tools/qa/people_gate.mjs: a verdict whose hashes are not the tree's is stale and counts as red. A '*' matches within one path segment. Add a file here when it starts to decide how people look or move; never take one out to make a verdict fresh.
aliases_about: A fight's state set introduced after a baseline verdict, and the set it was measured under before (its baseline key). tools/qa/people_gate.mjs compares a new verdict with the one it replaces on the baseline's keys: each measure's failing cells of an aliased set are summed into the baseline set's (e.g. 'A1 combat:strike2' into 'A1 combat:strike'), so a state moved to a set of its own is never compared against nothing. Introduced with combat set v4 (2026-11-18): the gate now measures each person's fight records under the set of the state the table plays for them (HumanMotionGateTests.Fighting), and v4 put its two-handed blows (club2_strike, club2_strike_b) in 'strike2' and its slips and ducks (miss_left, miss_right, miss_duck) in 'dodge', each to the limits real actors of that action set (docs/qa/motion_calibration.md §8; docs/PEOPLE_MOTION.md §2.7, §1.9). Both were measured under 'strike' in the baseline: the blows as the strike action, and every miss as that action's block ('combat:strike:<arms>_block'), whatever the table's own gate for misses then ('hit'). Never alias a set to hide a regression: a set is aliased only to the one its states were measured under in the baseline.
remeasured_about: Measures whose definition or limit was made stricter in the gate's code since the verdict before (by name, with why): only these are left out of the never-worse comparison while the two verdicts' measures hashes differ. Empty for combat set v4 (2026-11-18): its limit changes (§8's aim, two-handed blows, dodge) only loosen or add.

introduced.FY1: 2026-11-18: the pelvis's yaw against the fight's target (aim, the long gun's ready, strike), a new measure closing a gate hole (combat set v4.1's take-frame clips played with the body 180 deg from the target, docs/COMBAT_ROOT_CAUSE.md 11)
introduced.FY2: 2026-11-18: the chest's yaw against the fight's target, with FY1

introduced_about: A measure added after the verdict a batch is compared with: its cells are no regression of an old key. Left out of the comparison and of the totals while the measures' hash differs from that verdict's (tools/qa/gate_ratchet.mjs exempt); from the first verdict committed on its code it is compared as any other. Never used to hide an old measure's regression.
